sections.description: Where section files (Markdown + {{props}}) live. Globs are relative to this config file.

root.description: Section ids are computed relative to this directory (default: the config directory).

targets.description: Where target definition files (JSON) live: `*.target.ggen.json`, `*.agent.ggen.json` or `*.doc.ggen.json` by default.

agents.description: Deprecated alias of `targets`; both are read and merged.

props.description: Project-wide props. They override agent props but are overridden by CLI --set.

outDir.description: Default output directory for built agents.
